d: The Specilaist– HRIS is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing HR systems and technology platforms. The role ensures data accuracy, system efficiency, reporting excellence, and continuous improvement of HR processes through technology solutions. The analyst works closely with HR stakeholders, IT teams, and system vendors to support business requirements, enhance user experience, and provide actionable workforce insights.
q: Maintain and support HR systems, including employee data, organizational structures, workflows, and security roles.
Monitor system performance and troubleshoot HRIS-related issues.
Serve as the first point of contact for HRIS inquiries and system support requests.
Coordinate system upgrades, patches, testing, and releases.
Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and confidentiality of HR data.
Conduct regular audits and data validation exercises.
Support data governance initiatives and compliance requirements.
Develop and maintain HR data standards and documentation.
Generate regular and ad-hoc HR reports and dashboards.
Analyze workforce data and provide insights to support decision-making.
Develop KPI dashboards related to recruitment, turnover, diversity, performance, and workforce planning.
Support leadership reporting requirements using tools such as Power BI and HR reporting platforms.
Identify opportunities to automate and streamline HR processes.
Gather business requirements and support system enhancement initiatives.
Participate in HR transformation and digitalization projects.
Assist in the implementation of new HR modules and integrations.
Collaborate with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, IT, and external vendors.
Deliver user training and develop system guides and process documentation.
Support change management activities related to HR technology initiatives.
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.
Professional certifications in HRIS, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday, or HR Analytics are preferred.
2+ years of experience in HRIS, HR Analytics, or HR Technology.
Experience working with HR systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, or similar platforms.
Experience with data analysis, reporting, and dashboard development.
